title: Bellaire Medical: nurse trapped in an exam room, fire in the back hallway

lines.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?
Sixty five fifty Mapleridge Street, the Bellaire medical building! There's a fire in the back hallway, the smoke is pouring out the rear door!
Yes! One of our nurses is stuck in exam room one oh four. The hallway is full of smoke and she can't get out.
She's coughing a lot. She says the door is too hot to open.
I'm outside in the parking lot, on the street side.
Stay there. Help is on the way.
